what_settlement_high_is: NOT handed over by the venue. Most rows carry settlement_source 'daily_summary', i.e. our own maximum over an observation series across the recorded daily_max_window. The gap columns are that series' recorded coverage holes, in minutes.
why_it_matters: Every Brier number in this campaign scores against settlement_high. A coverage gap can make the label an UNDER-read of the day's true maximum. On 2026-06-09, chicago, atlanta and san-francisco settled with material gaps of 45.736, 45.726 and 45.699 minutes simultaneously -- a fleet-wide stall, not a station fault.
